summary: @lonseidman Think we are seeing this in the rise of "retro games" my kids don't paly 8-bit games because they think the 80's are cool (that's like saying dinosaurs are cool, everyone knows it but nobody knows what it means) but the simple load time and gratifying awards.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @lonseidman Think we are seeing this in the rise of "retro games" my kids don't paly 8-bit games because they think the 80's are cool (that's like saying dinosaurs are cool, everyone knows it but nobody knows what it means) but the simple load time and gratifying awards.
